FinishOAMWriteRt.name: Finish OAM write and solid-sprite helpers
summary: FinishOAMWriteRt: converts the tiles a sprite wrote to the OAM buffer. The OAM positions are screen-relative; this recomputes each tile's
level position and sets the OAM X bit 8 for tiles past the screen edge, hides tiles that are off-screen vertically (Y = $F0), and sets tile size.
Parameters: A: number of tiles - 1, Y: size bits ($00 = 8x8, $02 = 16x16), X: sprite index. Returns: X = sprite index.
$01B844: carry = tile X in $04/$05 off-screen. $01B852: solid sprite (turn block bridge): Mario stands on, bumps or is pushed away; $00/$02 set by caller.
$01B8FF: builds the sprite box from $00/$02 and tests contact with Mario (carry).

InitHorzNetKoopa.name: Init horizontal net Koopa
summary: X speed = +8 or -8 toward Mario, then runs the common net Koopa init at $01B950.

InitVertNetKoopa.name: Init vertical net Koopa and net Koopa common init
summary: Vertical (sprites $22/$23): state = 1, X speed = 1, Y speed = $F8. Common part at $01B950: sets the in-front/behind-net flag from X bit 4
and doubles both speeds when palette bit 1 of the sprite is clear (probably the green, faster one).
Horizontal Koopas ($24/$25) enter at $01B93E and share this code.

s01B973.name: Table: net Koopa turn palette bit

ClimbingKoopa.name: Net Koopa main
summary: Sprites $22-$25. Walks along the net (state 0 horizontal, 1 vertical) and turns around when blocked or when it runs off the net tiles (Map16 $07-$1C).
[$1540] is the turn timer: $50 at start, while $30-$3F draws turning frames, at $40 it flips the in-front/behind flag, direction and Y speed.
Draws with SubSprGfx1; animation direction flips every 8 frames using [$1570]. Behind-net sprites use priority [$64] = $10.

InitClimbingDoor.name: Init climbing net door
summary: Offsets the sprite by (+8, +7).

s01BA95.name: Unused data, then door X offset table

s01BAA7.name: Table: climbing door frames per step

ClimbingDoor.name: Climbing net door main
summary: Sprite $54. When Mario punches the net next to it ([$149E] probably the punch flag) a 6 frame delay starts in [$154C]; at 1 it plays sound $0F,
generates tile $19, and starts the $1F frame door swing in [$1540]. At [$1540] = $10 it toggles Mario's behind-scenery flag [$13F9]; at 1 it generates tile $1A.
Draws nine 16x16 tiles at OAM $0330: the door halves slide by DATA_01BA97 and unused columns get X bit 8 so they are hidden.
$01BC1D: sets Mario's 16x16 clipping box ($00-$03, $08, $09).

MagikoopasMagic.name: Magikoopa magic main
summary: Sprite $20. Moves and checks the block above it; when it hits a ceiling it plays sound 1, dies, and if the block tile is $11-$2D turns it into a sprite chosen
from a random number ($78 1-Up, $21, $27, else $07) and replaces the block with block $02. Also spawns smoke (CODE_01BD98).
Otherwise interacts with sprites and Mario, cycles its palette from MagiKoopasMagicPals and despawns below the screen.

StoreSpriteNum.name: Spawn sprite from the magic
summary: Entry with Y = sprite number from the random pick; initialises it at the block position.
